sample_unit: real user dialogues reviewed in controlled release

links.outcome: Rate of clinically inaccurate or unsafe chatbot responses in clinician-reviewed real user dialogues
links.effect: Clinically inaccurate responses in 0.90% (47/5195) of dialogues; unsafe responses within severity thresholds; below 2% inaccurate across clinician review stages, no high-severity unsafe responses.
links.quote: Clinically inaccurate responses occurred in 0.90% (47/5195) of dialogues, with unsafe responses within severity thresholds.

unlisted_practices: Synthetic test cases with predefined precision and recall thresholds
Medically led interdisciplinary three-phase chatbot development process

screen.reason: The study evaluates a multi-stage safety framework including synthetic testing, vulnerability testing, and controlled deployment with clinician monitoring for an LLM chatbot deployed to real users.

primary.practice: multi-stage safety evaluation framework and controlled release monitoring
